story: The Tawny Eagle (Aquila rapax) is an extraordinary bird that belongs to the Accipitridae family. It is most commonly observed in Arid/semi-arid habitats: deserts; steppes; open savannah; grassland; and dry woodland, where its behaviors contribute to the ecological dynamics of the area. Listed as Vulnerable (VU) by the IUCN, this species' future depends on continued conservation action. The story of the Tawny Eagle is one of adaptation and resilience, offering valuable lessons for conservationists. This poster aims to bring the Tawny Eagle into focus, highlighting its beauty and the importance of its habitat.
